howToPlay: Use Squeak to control areas by throwing sticky blobs that attach to enemies and walls. Utilize the Super to cover wide spaces and combine gadgets and Star Powers to maximize explosive damage and slow down opponents.
gears: Equip DAMAGE and HEALTH to stay in the fight longer and increase output. SPEED is effective for map mobility, while SHIELD provides extra durability.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy tactical area control and indirect fire gameplay.
